description: This file defines the VacancyAttachmentDecorator class, a decorator for handling VacancyAttachment entities within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It provides methods for retrieving file content and associating vacancies by ID.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional functionality for VacancyAttachment entities, including file content access and vacancy association.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a VacancyAttachment entity.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content from the attachment, reading from a resource if necessary.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Associates the decorator's VacancyAttachment with a Vacancy entity identified by ID.
